name: Blue-Green-Deployment-Setup
summary: Implement a blue-green deployment strategy using AWS CodeBuild and Elastic Beanstalk for zero-downtime deployments.
description: This project aims to establish a robust blue-green deployment strategy utilizing AWS CodeBuild and Elastic Beanstalk to ensure zero-downtime deployments for your applications. The blue-green deployment method allows for seamless transitions between application versions by maintaining two identical environments: one active (blue) and one idle (green). During the deployment process, updates are made to the green environment, which can be thoroughly tested before switching traffic from the blue environment. This strategy minimizes downtime and reduces the risk of deployment failures. The project will involve configuring AWS CodeBuild for continuous integration, setting up Elastic Beanstalk environments, and implementing the necessary scripts for automated deployment. By the end of this project, your team will have a fully functional blue-green deployment setup that enhances your development operations and ensures a smooth user experience during updates.
deliverables: Configuration of AWS CodeBuild for CI/CD (document)
